parts.note_add: Diagrams: S-005 Body-Index p.42-45 (figs 5310A-1, 5310A-2, 5340A-1, 5360A-1); underbody datum holes and point-to-point dimensions S-002 Section 14 p.24 (14-24). 1982 overall dimensions from S-038 p.9: length 4,285, width 1,650 (1,675 over the side protectors), height 1,260 mm. S-047 (printed p.24, PDF p.32) lists high-strength-steel panels for the 323 and 626 only; the RX-7 is not in that table.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.25 (fig 0900A-1): key sub sets FA01-76-210 R / FA01-76-220 L are the '81-'82 numbers ('83 uses FA43-); key blank 8208-75-901 ('81-'82, item 75158), primary key 8208-75-901 x2. Ilco cross-reference (PDF p.11): 1981-82 RX-7 all locks = Ilco X26 / MZ9, code series 2500-2999. The complete 81-83 lock set FA01-09-010B is NLA (Atkins, was $600); the key-cylinder gasket 0223-58-962 is in stock at Atkins ($2.40); Mazdatrix sells a 70-82 key blank ($21, type A or B by groove). Removal: S-002 Section 14 p.10 (cylinder held by a clip, rod end to the lock). No new door cylinder found for sale (2026-09-27); used only.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.25 (fig 0900A-1, item 75960): FA01-76-260 is the '81-'82 number, '83 uses FA43-76-230. Same key blank as the doors (8208-75-901; Ilco X26 / MZ9). Hatch lock adjustment: S-002 Section 14 p.12 (loosen the lock bolts, align to the striker). No new or used cylinder found for sale (2026-09-27).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.25 (fig 0900A-1, item 42440). Nothing found for sale new or used (two searches, 2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.26 (fig 5000A-1). Genuine skin FA01-50-030A is discontinued by Mazda (Mazdatrix, was $814.77) but Atkins Rotary still stocks it at $875 (primed, with hardware, no headlamp-washer holes; 11.99 lb). Face is urethane; removal and the installed height 450-514 mm at the protector rubber: S-002 Section 14 p.5-6. Urethane repair limits: S-047 p.11-13 (hole under 50 mm, crack under 200 mm).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.26 (fig 5000A-1, item 50040). S-047 (printed p.24) lists 'bumper beam' as 50-100 kg/mm2 high-strength steel for the 323 and 626 only; the RX-7 is not in that table. Nothing for sale found (2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.26 (fig 5000A-1): FA01-50-014 x2 and FA01-50-016 x2 are for FB331 chassis 500763 onward; early '81 cars (500001-500762) used FA01-50-012 x5 instead. The bumper height spec is measured at the centre of this protector rubber (S-002 Section 14 p.6). Nothing for sale found (2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.26 (fig 5000A-1). Inspection: measure length A (275.5 +/-2 mm) and replace if out of spec; length B (132.5 +/-1 mm) is set by moving the bracket (S-002 Section 14 p.6, 1985 figures). Atkins' rear shock 8871-50-290 is listed for 79-80 only (a year split, Atkins); no 81-85 front bumper shock found for sale (2026-09-27).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.26 (fig 5000A-1, items 50042D/50043D/50052D/50053D). Nothing for sale found (2026-09-27).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.26 (fig 5000A-1, item 50030). FA01-50-180 is discontinued by Mazda (Mazdatrix); used ones appear at Autopartone ($25, sold out 2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.27 (fig 5005A-1). FA01-50-711A is discontinued by Mazda (Mazdatrix, was $94.50); used 81-83 grilles with screws sell at Autopartone ($75, sold out 2026-09-27). The grille comes off to remove the front bumper (S-002 Section 14 p.6).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.27 (fig 5005A-1, items 50740/50760). Nothing for sale found (two searches, 2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.28 (fig 5010A-1). Bumper Megastore sells a reconditioned genuine FA01-50-220 cover ($473.92, 2026-09-27). Face is urethane; removal (service hole cover off from inside the hatch) and the installed height 474-534 mm at the protector rubber: S-002 Section 14 p.6-7. Urethane repair limits: S-047 p.11-13.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.28 (fig 5010A-1, item 50230). S-047 (printed p.24) marks 'bumper beam' as high-strength steel for the 323 and 626 only; the RX-7 is not in that table. Nothing for sale found (2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.28 (fig 5010A-1): FA01-50-013 x3, FA01-50-014 x2. The rear bumper height spec is measured at the centre of this protector rubber (S-002 Section 14 p.7). Nothing for sale found (2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.28 (fig 5010A-1, item 50200A). Inspection: measure length A (269 +/-2 mm) and replace if out of spec; length B (113 +/-1 mm) is set by moving the bracket (S-002 Section 14 p.7, 1985 figures). Atkins' 8871-50-290 rear shock is listed for 79-80 only (a year split, Atkins); no 81-85 rear bumper shock found for sale (2026-09-27).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.28 (fig 5010A-1, items 50042E/50052E/50233B/50243B). Nothing for sale found (2026-09-27).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.28 (fig 5010A-1, item 50311A). Nothing for sale found (2026-09-27).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.28 (fig 5010A-1, item 50340). Nothing for sale found under FA01-50-380 (2026-09-27); Autopartone's used rear holder is listed for 84-85 only.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.93 (fig 6300A-1, item 63901; GS/GSL glass FA01-63-901B, S model FA02-63-901F). Aftermarket glass is NAGS FW00462 (FW 462 GGN): FYG at Kool Katz ($279, green tint with green shade band, 2026-09-27); rx7club reports XYG/PPG/Pilkington mid-grade at about $136 wholesale and one number for all 79-85. Replacement procedure with the piano-wire cut, dam, primer, sealant and cure times: S-002 Section 14 p.20-22 (tool set 49 0305 870A).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.29 (fig 5030A-1). The upper joint is sold as 8871-50-950C (Atkins, $35, NLA with a few left, out of stock 2026-09-27). Clips are still available: 1243-50-609 top/bottom (Atkins $4.75 each, 14 per car - 7 top, 7 bottom; Mazdatrix $5.50 and says 16) and 8871-50-608 side (Atkins $5.12, 6 per car). The upper moulding sets themselves were not found new.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.29 (fig 5030A-1). Mazdatrix lists the right side windshield trim under 8871-50-680F, discontinued by Mazda (differs from the catalogue set number 8871-99-743B: check which supersedes). Side clip 8871-50-608 (6 per car) is in stock at Mazdatrix ($6.10) and Atkins ($5.12).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.29 (fig 5030A-1, item 50505T). Nothing found new for 8871-99-745A (2026-09-27); it shares the 1243-50-609 clips with the upper mouldings.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.30 (fig 5040A-1). Owners remove it by hand (thumbs at the bottom, pull the top) and refit it starting at the bottom with a mallet; the clips break easily and are the usual casualty (rx7club). Nothing for sale found for 8871-50-510C/520C (2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.31 (fig 5060A-1). Mazdatrix (2026-09-27) still stocks the door pieces C (R FA02-50-683 $259.88, L FA02-50-693 $256.35) and the front fender front piece A (R FA01-50-681 $89.64); the other seven are discontinued by Mazda. The protectors add 25 mm to the overall width (1,675 vs 1,650 mm, S-038 p.9).
Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.39 (fig 5170A-1, item 51545). Nothing found for sale or described online (two searches, 2026-09-27).

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.39 (fig 5170A-1, item 51721). Genuine 8871-51-721 is in stock at Atkins ($35.95): two-pin chrome fender badge, fixed with speed nuts 0187-69-049A; Atkins lists it for 79-82 while the catalogue carries it through 83: check.

Diagram: S-005 Body-Index p.39 (fig 5170A-1, item 51771). rx7club: the 81-83 front ornament F001-51-771 (rear F001-51-781) is a two-pin part, 84-85 changed to F023-51-770A with three pins (rears differ only by metal vs plastic clips); the thread found most numbers still in Mazda inventory with only F001-51-781 unavailable, Mazdatrix lists none of them, and a chrome 626 badge of the same shape is the usual substitute. Free printable front/rear plates: cad rx7-emblem-printables-lovc.
